name: humanintheloop
description: VS Code Language Model Tool for getting human feedback.

languageModelTools.name: humanInTheLoopFeedback
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get feedback from a human user. Accepts a markdown-formatted prompt string and returns the user's feedback text.

prompt.description: The markdown-formatted prompt to show to the user

languageModelTools.name: humanInTheLoopChoice
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Present choices to a human user and get their selection. Accepts a markdown-formatted prompt string and an array of choice strings.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Ask for a choice from the user.

prompt.description: The markdown-formatted prompt to show to the user

choices.description: The array of choices to present to the user

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
